title: Whether killing a creature will upset Lys seems to hinge on 'blighted vs. ordinary wildlife,' but that distinction isn't consistently flagged in the room text before you commit to the fight — the gray boar's room text called it 'blight-pale' up front, but the gaunt wolf that triggered Lys's disapproval carried no such warning before the attack.
